newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage 11.1 pct up in March.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage 11.1 pct up in March.

text.p: The average monthly net wage in Romania rose by 11.1 percent in March from the previous month and by 93.3 percent year-on-year, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.
But March's wage increase was below record 30.7 percent monthly inflation, triggering a 15 percent fall in purchasing power last month, a CNS report said.
It said purchasing power was also 26.8 percent down year-on-year and 49.5 percent of the level in October 1990, when prices were first liberalised in Romania.
Employees in the financial sector had the highest net wage of 1.19 million lei on average, while hotels and restaurants workers had the lowest pay -- 457,057 lei.
Romania employed 5.532 million people at end-March, 30,200 more than the previous month after a rise in the number of employees in the construction and farming sectors.
